sentences.text: As per prosecution case , the informant got married with this petitioner in the year 2020 and after the marriage , when she went to her matrimonial house, she was subjected to torture and cruelty by this petitioner and other in-laws family members due to non-fulfillment of demand of dowry and lastly, she was ousted from her matrimonial house .
4. Petitioner No. 1 is sister-in - law , petitioner No. 2 is brother-in - law , petitioner No. 3 is father-in-law , petitioner No. 4 brother-in - law of the victim.
They are separate in mess and property.
There is no specific allegation is alleged against them and they have no concern with the affairs of the couple .
Thrust of accusation is against the husband of the victim who is already in custody .
Petitioners claim clean antecedent.
5 . Learned counsel for the State opposes the bail petition .

6. Considering the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case, in the event of arrest or surrender within six weeks from today, let this petitioner, as named above, be enlarged on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs.10,000/-(ten thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of the learned J M 1st Class Danapur in connection with Maner P. Patna High Court CR. MISC.
No.55091 of 2024(4) dt.09-01-2025 S. Case No . 807 of 2023 , subject to the conditions laid down under section 438 of the Code of Criminal Procedure .
